Method of Attack: Leveraging CVE-2023-33246 exploit to drop XMRig Monero miners on vulnerable servers
Discoverer: Rongtong Jin (Apache RocketMQ Project Management Committee member, Alibaba)
Impacted Systems: Apache RocketMQ versions 5.1 and older, including NameServer component
Attack Vector: Exploitation of remote command execution vulnerability via update configuration function on exposed NameServer addresses without proper permission checks
Indicators of Compromise: Hundreds of IP addresses scanning or attempting to exploit Apache RocketMQ services
Activity logged by The ShadowServer Foundation
Exploitation attempts observed since at least August 2023
